data_source: frozen LEVEL2_OOF_FROZEN.npz generated from official GSE207049 voom_resid
outer_folds: reuse exact frozen pilot fold vector; no resplitting
primary_target: DEX minus ETOH minus outer-training LCL mean response

boosting.implementation: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor, one regressor per training-response PC

deep_residual_mlp.primary_prediction: arithmetic mean across three seed predictions

models: best nonlinear by full-cohort pooled OOF residual R2
ancestry_sensitivity.split: fixed-seed shuffled biological-LCL KFold within ancestry

measurement_coupling.complete_definition: two independently labelled ETOH versions and two matching DEX versions
measurement_coupling.near_pair_rule: one nearest other LCL per predictor-replicate-A baseline
measurement_coupling.coupling_not_sufficient_to_explain_gate: replicate-B residual reliability positive and baseline-A versus response-B distance Spearman <= 0.20

pretrained_encoder.compatibility_requirement: official raw-count single-cell input without feature selection and with total counts
pretrained_encoder.incompatible_action: PRETRAINED_ENCODER_NOT_INPUT_COMPATIBLE; do not install or fabricate counts

reliability_adjustment.method: two-replicate random-effects variance decomposition on replicate-complete LCLs

forbidden: coupled geometry as positive verdict evidence
